claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_lineage_progression_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is a build-time choice over lineage packages with level-gated grants at character levels 1, 3, and 5. The current species-trait families only support a flat passive grant list or a single activated ability.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellcastingAbilityChoice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The lineage-granted spells use a build-time choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as their spellcasting ability, and the current spell-access grant shape has no way to carry that binding.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.mutable_cantrip_list
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf pressure requires a granted cantrip that can be replaced on each Long Rest from a named spell list, which the current spell-access modes do not model.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
